purpose: temporal/regime anomaly diagnosis; not PnL parameter optimization

state_definitions.volatility: rolling std of up to 120 open-to-open log returns, known at entry
state_definitions.activity: previous completed H1 volume divided by rolling median of recent positive-volume H1 bars
state_definitions.round_distance: distance from entry open to nearest 0.10 JPY level, in pips

notes: Direction in the descriptive full-sample panel is oriented to the sign of the full-sample raw effect; do not treat it as untouched OOS evidence.
walk_forward_years chooses direction from prior years only and is the cleaner forward-style diagnostic.
change_points are descriptive mean-shift candidates, not formal multiple-testing-adjusted discoveries.
composition_bp estimates how much monthly strength is associated with the mix of observed market states; structural_residual_bp is the remaining month effect.
